profile.headline: Software Engineer at Hadrian
profile.summary: A software developer powered by beautiful code and a lifelong passion for learning.

positions.title: Front End Engineer II - AWS Lambda
positions.description:
⇢ Led integration of Visual Studio Code into the AWS Lambda Console, driving 97% adoption across hundreds of thousands of developers
⇢Built and architected browser-based developer tooling including embedded IDE infrastructure, extension systems, and secure credential routing
⇢Delivered Amazon Q AI coding assistance integration for web-based development workflows, enabling hundreds of thousands of weekly code suggestions
⇢Improved frontend performance by reducing Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) significantly though lazy loading feature gating system
⇢Drove accessibility initiatives and large-scale frontend platform improvements across the Lambda Console experience
⇢Designed secure browser architectures involving iframe sandboxing, cross-origin isolation (COOP/COEP), SharedArrayBuffer, and WebAssembly-based capabilities
⇢Collaborated cross-functionally with security, legal, platform, and principal engineering teams to deliver large-scale, cross-service developer platform initiatives

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
⇢ Continued development and support of eVentilator application created for Children’s Hospital of Los Angeles
⇢ Created medical image upload portal wizard for Illuminostics, Inc.
⇢ Developed banking loan analysis application for GainOps, Inc.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
⇢ Created banking software which groups and evaluates loans via a complex algorithmic methods.
• Performance and optimization were key, including algorithms implemented in NodeJS as well as complex SQL queries on 1M+ loan records.
⇢ Sole developer guiding non-technical banking clients in order to determine their needs.
⇢ UI development in ReactJS using MaterialUI components.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
⇢ Created user friendly upload wizard for medical image data
• Leveraged modern web technologies, including React, FlowJS, and MaterialUI components.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
⇢ Created software products to facilitate research within the Hospital
  • Modern web applications enabling advanced clinical decision support
  • RESTful APIs to expose data from Hadoop, SQL, and NoSQL data sources
⇢ Extensive experience with React and React ecosystem
⇢ Created the eVentiltor application for real-time Ventilator management
  • REDVent study for which this was created: https://clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/NCT03266016
  • Implements structured ventilation protocol
  • Quantify patient outcome improvements by increased adherence to protocol
  • Identify issues with protocol which cause poor adherence or patient outcome

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
⇢ Set technological direction for front-end
⇢ Introduced asynchronous loading, module system, concatenation, minification, caching, build processes
⇢ Migrated existing codebase to Backbone.js
⇢ Full stack development - supported API consumed by iOS, Android and web clients

positions.title: Python Developer
positions.description:
⇢ Re-implemented existing PHP product and order management website using Python and Flask
⇢ Integrated email solutions from Sendgrid including email tracking and reporting

positions.title: Head of Information Technology
positions.description:
⇢ Analyzed stock trading strategies using Visual Basic, Python and Excel with a 
focus on correlating broker behavior and stock performance
⇢ Automated many essential business work-flows by using Python and a collection 
of custom databases
⇢ Improved efficiency, allowing the book keeping to be performed by a single 
individual rather than a team of book keepers
 This improved efficiency allowed us to expand our business, increasing trading activity and the number of accounts we held
 Administrated network of 10+ machines including Windows, Mac, and Linux 
systems to guarantee consistent uptime
 Ensured reliable backups were made and security measures were taken
